transcript.text: Hello! Today we will learn basic addition and subtraction using simple numbers.

transcript.speaker: user_A
transcript.text: Let's start with addition. When you add two numbers together, you get a sum. For example, two plus three equals five.

transcript.speaker: user_B
transcript.text: That makes sense. Can you show me another example?

transcript.speaker: user_A
transcript.text: Sure! Let's try four plus six. If you count four items and add six more items, you have ten items total.

transcript.speaker: user_A
transcript.text: Now subtraction is the opposite. When you subtract, you take away. Five minus two equals three.

transcript.speaker: user_B
transcript.text: Got it! So subtraction removes numbers.

transcript.speaker: user_A
transcript.text: Exactly right! Let's practice counting backwards. Start at ten and subtract one each time.
